Scan One Genomic Chunk's Sliding Windows with GLOW

Source: R/glow_scan_chunk.R
glow_scan_chunk.Rd

Opens the chunk's GDS once and runs the single-region GLOW test (GLOWr::glow_region_test()) over every window in a regions table, accumulating the always-on flat results table and the artifacts requested by output_policy. This is the orchestration core of the sliding-window scan; the workflow scripts wrap it per chunk.

glow_scan_chunk(
  gds_path,
  regions,
  null_model,
  pi_models,
  pi_features,
  reference_medians,
  b_func = NULL,
  b_model = NULL,
  filter_spec,
  ld_threshold = 0.9,
  mac_threshold = 10L,
  collapse_method = "mean",
  use_spa = NULL,
  z_scale = 1,
  region_summary = FALSE,
  output_policy,
  staar_context = NULL,
  progress_every = 0L,
  progress_callback = NULL,
  variant_index = NULL,
  verbose = 0
)

Arguments

gds_path

Path to the chunk's GDS/aGDS file. Opened read-only once and reused across windows (closed on exit).

regions

A regions table (the GLOWr::define_regions_window() shape: chr, start, end, and ideally label). All rows must be on a single chromosome (chunks are per-chromosome, and reference_medians is that chromosome's cache).

null_model, pi_models, pi_features, reference_medians, b_func, b_model, filter_spec, ld_threshold, mac_threshold, collapse_method

Passed through to GLOWr::glow_region_test() for every window (exactly one of b_func/b_model). reference_medians is the chunk chromosome's cached annotation medians.

use_spa

Logical or NULL (default NULL). Threaded to GLOWr::glow_region_test(): selects GLOW's single-variant score statistics (NULL = auto: SPA for binary, standard for continuous; TRUE = force SPA, binary only; FALSE = force standard). GLOW-only — STAAR is decided solely by staar_context and always runs non-SPA. Validated up front (a TRUE + continuous mismatch fails once, before the GDS is opened).

z_scale

Numeric scalar (default 1). Threaded to GLOWr::glow_region_test(): the M2 single-variant confounding correction (1/sqrt(inflation_factor)) applied to each unit's Z before the GLOW combination. z_scale = 1 is a no-op.

region_summary

Logical (default FALSE). Pass-through to GLOWr::glow_region_test(): when TRUE the flat table gains 7 region-summary columns (n_collapsed_units, min_MAF, max_MAF, min_MAC, max_MAC, min_p_standard, min_p_SPA) placed after is_single. These are the gene scan's per-gene diagnostic columns; the gene scans turn this on. Default FALSE leaves the sliding/coding flat schema unchanged.

output_policy

A glow_output_policy from glow_output_policy().

staar_context

A STAAR context (see GLOWr::glow_region_test()) or NULL (STAAR off).

progress_every

Integer. If positive, emit a progress line every N windows (after window N, 2N, ...). Default 0L (off). Useful for long chunks where a silent log otherwise looks indistinguishable from a hang.

progress_callback

Optional function(msg) taking the formatted progress string. Default NULL routes to message(). Pass a logger (e.g. the workflow's log_msg) to write progress into the run's per-chunk log.

variant_index

A glow_variant_index for gds_path from GLOWr::build_variant_index(), or NULL (default), in which case the engine builds it once after opening the GDS. Every region's lookup uses it (see GLOWr::extract_variant_set()); a caller that already holds the index for this file (as run_scan_unit does) passes it to avoid a second build.

verbose

Integer (default 0). Threaded to the single-region test.

Value

A list with:

results

A data.frame, one row per non-skipped window, with the flat-table schema: label, chr, start, end, midpoint; n_variants, n_after_annotation, n_after_filter, n_after_ld, n_after_collapse, cMAC (where n_after_annotation = after QC+type+annotation, before MAF/MAC; in the coding analysis = the per-category raw SNV count); is_single; (when region_summary = TRUE) the 7 region-summary columns; the 16 GLOW_* columns; the 8 STAAR_* columns. 0-row (full schema) for an empty chunk.

evidence

A named list of per-window evidence packets (keyed by window label) for kept windows, or NULL when write_evidence is off.

staar_detail

A named list of full STAAR() outputs (keyed by label) for windows where STAAR ran, or NULL when write_staar_detail is off.

result_objects

A named list of per-window result rows (keyed by label) when write_result_objects is on, else NULL. (The single-region test exposes the flat row, not the raw glow_test_result S3 object.)

errors

A data.frame(label, message) of windows that errored (0-row when none).

summary

A 1-row data.frame: n_windows, n_ok, n_skip_empty, n_staar_skip_single, n_error, runtime_secs.

Details

STAAR on/off is decided solely by staar_context: non-NULL turns STAAR on for every window (passed straight to the single-region test); NULL leaves the 8 STAAR columns all-NA. output_policy$write_staar_detail therefore requires a non-NULL staar_context, which is validated here (the single cross-check that glow_output_policy() deliberately omits).

Per-window status handling (from the single-region test's $status):

"ok" / "staar_skip_single"

A flat row is appended; STAAR columns carry the single-region test's p-values ("ok" with STAAR on) or NA (staar_skip_single, or STAAR off). Evidence / staar_detail / result_objects are stashed if the policy enables them and the single-region test produced them.

"skip_empty"

Tallied; no row.

"error"

Tallied; the message recorded in $errors; no row. One window's error never aborts the chunk.

Empty chunk (every window skip_empty — common at fine scale on sparse data): $results is a 0-row data.frame carrying the full schema, so a downstream file-presence check stays uniform.

See also

glow_output_policy(), define_genome_chunks(), GLOWr::glow_region_test()
